# `morphir cache clean`

- **Usage:** `morphir cache clean [FLAGS]`

Remove known disposable cache entries

## Flags
- **`--dry-run`** — Report the cleanup plan without changing files
- **`--all`** — Remove every known disposable entry instead of applying policy
- **`--component <COMPONENT>`** — Limit cleanup to one registered cache component
- **`--json`** — Output the plan and execution report as JSON
